summary.headline: Planetary Epochs and Releases
summary.text: Astrological procedures for locating Venus and Mercury by epochs, elapsed years, days, and zodiacal releases, including Venus’s station dates and an example for Trajan. Worked calculations then place Saturn in Pisces, Jupiter in Sagittarius, and Mars in Taurus.
